items.problem: One rebuild failed with MSB 'The process cannot access the file ... AdaptiveStreaming.dll ... because it is being used by another process' (interop.targets 724).
items.evidence: session-log ~line 11486 'Build failed with 1 error(s) and 192 warning(s)'; the cleanup step then ran Stop-Process on the AdaptiveStreaming process.
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — this is a transient/environmental file lock (a previously launched app instance held the output dll), not a migration-code issue and not a skill topic.
items.why_no_skill_change: A stale running instance locking the build output is an environmental race the agent recovers from by stopping the process before rebuild; it does not recur from any skill guidance and needs no skill edit.
